verdict.rationale: Operating a scheduling SaaS through natural-language commands is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows a natural-language or conversational interface. The evidence covers a REST API, webhooks, a JS embed, Zapier and workflow automations, all of which are structured, not natural-language. "Delegate to an assistant" reads as a human-delegate feature, with no indication of AI. The probes also found no llms.txt and no OpenAPI spec.
